statements.text: The purpose of this document is to outline the Human Resources operational procedures for the Office of Human Resources at Crestwood University.
statements.quote: The purpose of this document is to outline the Human Resources operational procedures for the Office of Human Resources at Crestwood University.

statements.text: This SOP covers the end-to-end processes for employee onboarding, offboarding, leave management, performance management, and recruiting.

statements.text: Do not deviate from the procedures described in this document.

statements.text: If a situation arises that is not covered, escalate to the HR Director immediately by posting a notification in Slack [OUT OF SCOPE] – [email subject line].

statements.text: The HR Coordinator's role is administrative and digital – process cases using email, Slack, calendar, Jira, and the reference spreadsheets and document templates listed in Section 6.

statements.text: FMLA | Family and Medical Leave Act. Federal law entitling eligible employees to up to 12 weeks of unpaid, job-protected leave per year.
statements.quote: FMLA | Family and Medical Leave Act. Federal law entitling eligible employees to up to 12 weeks of unpaid, job-protected leave per year.

statements.text: ADA | Americans with Disabilities Act. Federal law requiring employers to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified employees with disabilities.
statements.quote: ADA | Americans with Disabilities Act. Federal law requiring employers to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified employees with disabilities.

statements.text: COBRA | Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act. Federal law requiring employers to offer continuation of group health coverage after a qualifying event.
statements.quote: COBRA | Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act. Federal law requiring employers to offer continuation of group health coverage after a qualifying event.

statements.text: PIP | Performance Improvement Plan. A formal, documented plan to address and correct employee performance deficiencies.
statements.quote: PIP | Performance Improvement Plan. A formal, documented plan to address and correct employee performance deficiencies.

statements.text: I-9 | Employment Eligibility Verification form. Federal form required within 3 business days of an employee's first day of work.
statements.quote: I-9 | Employment Eligibility Verification form. Federal form required within 3 business days of an employee's first day of work.

statements.text: PTO | Paid Time Off. Combined vacation and personal leave accrued by eligible employees.
statements.quote: PTO | Paid Time Off. Combined vacation and personal leave accrued by eligible employees.

statements.text: Qualifying Event | A life event (marriage, birth, divorce, loss of other coverage) that triggers eligibility for mid-year benefits enrollment changes or COBRA coverage.

statements.text: Exempt Employee | An employee exempt from overtime provisions of the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA), typically salaried.

statements.text: Non-Exempt Employee | An employee entitled to overtime pay under the FLSA, typically hourly.

statements.text: Probationary Period | The first 90 calendar days of employment for staff, or the first academic year for faculty.

statements.text: Where a section in this SOP specifies an exact Slack or Jira format, use that format.
statements.quote: Where a section in this SOP specifies an exact Slack or Jira format, use that format.

statements.text: Where no specific format is given and an action is required, use the defaults below.
statements.quote: Where no specific format is given and an action is required, use the defaults below.

statements.text: [SOP SUBHEADER]: [Employee Name], [Employee ID], Jira: [Ticket ID]
statements.quote: [SOP SUBHEADER]: [Employee Name], [Employee ID], Jira: [Ticket ID]

statements.text: *Example: FINAL PAY & ACCRUED PTO: Maria Torres, E-1042, Jira: OFFBOARD-Torres-03152026*
statements.quote: *Example: FINAL PAY & ACCRUED PTO: Maria Torres, E-1042, Jira: OFFBOARD-Torres-03152026*

statements.text: When creating a Jira ticket, the ticket description starts empty.
statements.quote: When creating a Jira ticket, the ticket description starts empty.

statements.text: Only add fields to the description when explicitly instructed by a section of this SOP.
statements.quote: Only add fields to the description when explicitly instructed by a section of this SOP.

statements.text: Use the exact field format below when adding each field:
statements.quote: Use the exact field format below when adding each field:

statements.text: Employee Name | Employee Name: [Full Name] | The section references a specific employee
statements.quote: Employee Name | Employee Name: [Full Name] | The section references a specific employee

statements.text: Employee ID | Employee ID: [ID] | The section references a specific employee
statements.quote: Employee ID | Employee ID: [ID] | The section references a specific employee

statements.text: Assignee | Assignee: [Full Name] | The section or routing table (Section 8) specifies who to assign the ticket to
statements.quote: Assignee | Assignee: [Full Name] | The section or routing table (Section 8) specifies who to assign the ticket to

statements.text: Priority | Priority: [P1/P2/P3/P4] | The section instructs you to assign a priority per Section 9
statements.quote: Priority | Priority: [P1/P2/P3/P4] | The section instructs you to assign a priority per Section 9

statements.text: Deadline | Deadline: [MM/DD/YYYY] | The section involves a compliance or action deadline
statements.quote: Deadline | Deadline: [MM/DD/YYYY] | The section involves a compliance or action deadline

statements.text: Status | Status: [value] | The section involves a compliance or action deadline
statements.quote: Status | Status: [value] | The section involves a compliance or action deadline

statements.text: When the SOP instructs you to update a Jira ticket (e.g., changing status or adding a deadline), update the relevant field in the description.
statements.quote: When the SOP instructs you to update a Jira ticket (e.g., changing status or adding a deadline), update the relevant field in the description.

statements.text: Use the Jira comment format to log the change.
statements.quote: Use the Jira comment format to log the change.

statements.text: [Date and time] [SOP SUBHEADER] — [Action] — [Object]
statements.quote: [Date and time] [SOP SUBHEADER] — [Action] — [Object]

statements.text: The Action must be one of the following:
statements.quote: The Action must be one of the following:

statements.text: TEMPLATE SENT | An email template was sent. Object = "Template [#] to [recipient email]"
statements.quote: TEMPLATE SENT | An email template was sent. Object = "Template [#] to [recipient email]"

statements.text: FILE ATTACHED | A file was attached to an outgoing email. Object = "[filename] to [recipient email]"
statements.quote: FILE ATTACHED | A file was attached to an outgoing email. Object = "[filename] to [recipient email]"

statements.text: EMAIL FORWARDED | An email was forwarded to an internal team member. Object = "to [recipient email]"
statements.quote: EMAIL FORWARDED | An email was forwarded to an internal team member. Object = "to [recipient email]"

statements.text: SPREADSHEET UPDATED | A spreadsheet field was updated. Object = "[filename] — [column name] set to [value]"
statements.quote: SPREADSHEET UPDATED | A spreadsheet field was updated. Object = "[filename] — [column name] set to [value]"

statements.text: CALENDAR EVENT CREATED | A Calendar event was created. Object = "[event title] on [MM/DD/YYYY]"
statements.quote: CALENDAR EVENT CREATED | A Calendar event was created. Object = "[event title] on [MM/DD/YYYY]"

statements.text: CALENDAR EVENT REMOVED | A Calendar event was deleted. Object = "[event title] on [MM/DD/YYYY]"
statements.quote: CALENDAR EVENT REMOVED | A Calendar event was deleted. Object = "[event title] on [MM/DD/YYYY]"

statements.text: SLACK POSTED | A Slack message was posted. Object = "[channel name]"
statements.quote: SLACK POSTED | A Slack message was posted. Object = "[channel name]"

statements.text: WAITING ON | The case is blocked pending input. Object = "[who] — [what is needed]"
statements.quote: WAITING ON | The case is blocked pending input. Object = "[who] — [what is needed]"

statements.text: CONFIRMED RECEIVED | Required documentation or confirmation was received. Object = "[document or item name] from [sender]"
statements.quote: CONFIRMED RECEIVED | Required documentation or confirmation was received. Object = "[document or item name] from [sender]"

statements.text: TICKET UPDATED | An update to a field in the Jira ticket description. Object = "[Field Name] from [old value] to [new value]"
statements.quote: TICKET UPDATED | An update to a field in the Jira ticket description. Object = "[Field Name] from [old value] to [new value]"

statements.text: ESCALATED | The case was escalated. Object = "to [recipient name/email] — [reason]"
statements.quote: ESCALATED | The case was escalated. Object = "to [recipient name/email] — [reason]"

statements.text: CLOSED | The ticket is complete. Object = "All steps completed."
statements.quote: CLOSED | The ticket is complete. Object = "All steps completed."
